title: Pause before you react
summary: Practise a 10-second pause when something annoys you.
objectives: Describe one pause tool (breath, count, step away)
Apply it to a realistic school or home scenario
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

When we feel heat rising, we often react first and think later.

Choose one pause tool:
1. Three slow breaths
2. Count 1–10
3. Step away for one minute

Read the scenario, pick a response, then reflect.

quiz.prompt: A classmate jokes about your project in front of others. You feel hot and angry. Which response uses a pause?

options.label: Take three breaths, then say you want to talk later

quiz.teachBack: A pause is not silence forever. It is space to choose a clearer next step.

reflectionPrompt: Name your pause tool. When will you try it this week?
successCriteria: Chooses a response that includes a pause
Names one pause tool for real life

supported.coachNote: Offer the three pause tools as a checklist.

steady.coachNote: Ask what usually happens in the first 5 seconds of anger.

fast.coachNote: Ask them to design a second scenario from their week.

llm.tutorBrief: Coach pause skills. Do not encourage aggression. Do not shame anger. Keep scenarios school/home appropriate.
